_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.en: In Cebu Province, Philippines, dengue is rising: as of 18 August this year, 2,324 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths; standing water has increased since the rainy season began in July, causing a marked rise. Neighbouring Bohol Province has also had an outbreak: as of 22 August this year, 1,883 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7% more than the same period last year, with at least 20 deaths. The case fatality rate (1.17%) exceeds the country's epidemic threshold (1%), and 12 administrative areas across the province have exceeded the threshold for three consecutive weeks; the outbreak is most serious in Talibon, Tagbilaran City and Ubay. Authorities have declared an outbreak alert. Malaysia's outbreak is rising rapidly: as of this year, more than 62,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 60 deaths, 60% more than the same period last year. Authorities have activated a response and are deploying hotspot measures in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, expanding the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for biological control, and conducting a cost-effectiveness analysis of a dengue vaccine to assess whether it could be included in the national routine vaccination programme. India reported 33,060 cases cumulatively through July this year, similar to the same period last year; 10,122 were added in July, 53% more than in June. Cases in India usually rise from May to June, at the start of the monsoon rains, and reach an annual peak in September–October. In Europe, as of 5 August this year, only France had reported 4 locally acquired cases. Studies show that climate change has made the risk of dengue outbreaks in Europe during 2015–24 three times that of 1982–2010.

zethE0SyDr2k7p8kCADljQ.en: As of 17 August this year, France has reported 25 confirmed locally acquired cases in three outbreak events; the largest occurred in western Gironde. Authorities have launched outbreak investigations and vector mosquito control, and assess that transmission risk will remain until November. France cumulatively reported 32 locally acquired cases during 2010–2024, but a large outbreak occurred last year (2025), with 809 locally acquired cases reported.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

p4xpsBMlWgJs9LtW0vrs1A.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 15 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Ituri Province (Mahagi), and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (46 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 90% of national cases. Uganda has reported no new cases since 22 June. Global overview: as of 15 July, the outbreak has spread to 4 countries, with 2,147 confirmed cases reported cumulatively, including 830 deaths (CFR: 38.7%). Most cases are in the DRC, with 2,124 confirmed cases (including 828 deaths and 390 recoveries). Neighbouring Uganda has 20 confirmed cases (including 2 deaths and 18 recoveries), all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. The United States has 2 cases (1 recovered) and France 1 case (recovered). These sporadic cases were all healthcare workers or humanitarian responders providing care in the DRC.

VpF4RVbNEldubDrSsKB4WA.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 10 July, the United States confirmed that a US citizen working in humanitarian aid in the DRC had been infected. In the past month, the patient mainly worked in logistics in Bunia, Ituri Province, and is currently being treated in isolation locally, which highlights the high exposure risk for frontline workers. The CDC assesses the domestic risk as low but urges the public to avoid travel to the three eastern DRC provinces. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 10 July, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 17 recoveries), with no community transmission.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

KtC9BySg7qmlLVJIO4gAoA.zh: 法國6/24報告首例自DRC境外移入確定病例,為人道救援醫師,目前病毒量低且病情穩定,正於醫院治療中,該國已啟動接觸者追蹤。
KtC9BySg7qmlLVJIO4gAoA.en: On 24 June, France reported its first imported confirmed case from the DRC, a humanitarian aid doctor. The patient's viral load is low and the condition is stable, and the patient is being treated in hospital. France has started contact tracing.

uhaI0N586_AuJtxE1TwzUA.zh: 法國普羅旺斯地區通報95例病例(15例確診),主要為學童,於近期參訪羅納河口省奧裡奧爾的一家教育農場後陸續發病,經調查為該農場未遵守飲用水供應規範所致,當局已要求該農場關閉並進行改善措施。
uhaI0N586_AuJtxE1TwzUA.en: The Provence region of France has reported 95 cases (15 confirmed), mainly schoolchildren, who fell ill after recently visiting an education farm in Auriol, Bouches-du-Rhône. Investigation found that the farm had not complied with drinking water supply standards. Authorities have ordered the farm to close and carry out improvement measures.

5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,多國自去(2025)年12月截至今年5月中旬累計報告至少83例病例,其中至少20例住院,病患以兒童及年輕人為多,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疫情分布於丹麥、匈牙利、捷克、法國等9個歐洲國家,經調查疑感染源為雞肉相關產品,受影響國家已要求廠商將相關產品下架。
5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.en: European outbreak update: between December 2025 and mid-May 2026, multiple countries reported at least 83 cases, of which at least 20 were hospitalised. Cases are mainly among children and young people. Genotyping identified Salmonella Stanley ST2045. The outbreak is spread across nine European countries, including Denmark, Hungary, Czechia and France. Investigations suggest the suspected source is chicken-related products, and affected countries have asked manufacturers to withdraw the products from the market.

bl9adP5_Pzdm2WPKHpuowg.zh: 法國波爾多5/13報告1艘英籍郵輪群聚事件,截至5/16累計報告60名乘客及4名工作人員出現腸胃症狀,超過1,700名乘客/船員被命令留在船上,經當局檢測確認為諾羅病毒感染後,始同意無症狀者下船。另先前有1名人員死亡,惟無腹瀉相關症狀,死因仍未確定。
bl9adP5_Pzdm2WPKHpuowg.en: On 13 May, Bordeaux, France, reported a cluster on a British-flagged cruise ship. As of 16 May, 60 passengers and four crew members had cumulatively reported gastrointestinal symptoms. More than 1,700 passengers and crew were ordered to remain on board. Only after authorities confirmed norovirus infection through testing did they agree to let asymptomatic people disembark. One crew member had previously died without diarrhoea-related symptoms, and the cause of death has not yet been determined.

oprXpTE3tYKmE48ZsTbjJg.zh: 印近期疫情升溫,多國報告旅遊相關病例。法國自2025下半年至今年3月累計報告11例境外移入確診病例(多具峇里島旅遊史),德國今年亦報告2例確診病例。當局呼籲赴該區旅客落實防蚊,孕婦與計畫受孕者須特別提高警覺。
oprXpTE3tYKmE48ZsTbjJg.en: Transmission has recently risen in Indonesia, and several countries have reported travel-related cases. France reported 11 imported confirmed cases cumulatively from the second half of 2025 to March this year, most with a history of travel to Bali. Germany has reported two confirmed cases this year. Authorities urge travellers to the area to protect themselves against mosquitoes, and pregnant women and those planning pregnancy should take particular care.

NKRAzW8UWtrpa11j26B5uw.zh: 法國於去(2025)年加強監測期間(5/1-11/30)在6個大區的17個省份發現62例人類感染病例,其中20例(32%)為神經侵襲性疾病,5例(8%)死亡,受影響最嚴重地區為普羅旺斯-阿爾卑斯-藍色海岸大區(30例)。該國自2017年以來,每年都有人類或馬匹感染病例被確診,證實病毒在該國境內持續傳播。
NKRAzW8UWtrpa11j26B5uw.en: During the enhanced surveillance period from 1 May to 30 November last year, France detected 62 human infection cases across 17 departments in six regions. Of these, 20 (32%) were neuroinvasive disease and five (8%) died. The most affected region was Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, with 30 cases. Since 2017, France has confirmed human or equine infection cases every year, showing that the virus continues to circulate within the country.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 11 週(3/16-22)全球陽性率上升為 2.47%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。 德國疫情呈下降,目前處低點,第 13 週新增 282 例病例;變異株以 NB.1.8.1(68%)為主,另變異株 BA.3.2 占比上升,從今年9-10 週的 5%,上升至第 10-11 週的 11%。 英國疫情略升,第 13 週實驗室檢測陽性率略增至 2.1%。變異株以 XFG 占大宗,BA.3 於 2/16-3/1 占比為 2.13%。 GISAID 去年 12 月迄今的病毒株定序資料顯示,BA.3.2 多數易感宿主為年輕族群,其中,愛爾蘭高達 38.8%及法國 27%病例為 18 歲以下族群;美國 49.1%及盧森堡 23.4%病例為 10 歲以下族群,與其他變異株感染病患的年齡層分布顯著不同。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 31.44%),其次為NB.1.8.1(30.68%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之 COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,惟不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,然有 6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
SIGR50MKplPxkwHqzYpK_w.en: Epidemic update: In week 11 of this year (16–22 March), the global positivity rate rose to 2.47%, with notable increases in the WHO South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean regions. Germany's epidemic is declining and is currently at a low point, with 282 new cases reported in week 13. NB.1.8.1 (68%) remains the predominant variant, while the share of BA.3.2 has risen from 5% in weeks 9–10 of this year to 11% in weeks 10–11. The UK's epidemic has risen slightly, and laboratory test positivity increased slightly to 2.1% in week 13. XFG accounts for the largest share of variants, and BA.3 accounted for 2.13% during 16 February–1 March. Sequencing data in GISAID since December last year show that most BA.3.2 infections occur in young people: 38.8% of cases in the Republic of Ireland and 27% in France were under 18 years, and 49.1% of cases in the United States and 23.4% in Luxembourg were under 10 years, a significantly different age distribution from patients infected with other variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently accounts for the highest share of circulating variants globally (31.44%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (30.68%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

rnVEHXwkyOnCvJDDcVP12Q.zh: 法國新增12例病例,其中2例死亡,病患採檢日介於2025年9月中旬至今年1/23,病患多為65歲以上。經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商販售的肉醬相關食品,產品已下架。另該國自2021年以來,感染病例持續增加,2024年累計報告619例病例。
rnVEHXwkyOnCvJDDcVP12Q.en: France has reported 12 new cases, including 2 deaths. Sampling dates for these patients range from mid-September 2025 to 23 January this year, and most patients are aged over 65. Authorities' investigation suggests the suspected source of infection is a meat paste product from a certain producer; the product has been withdrawn. In addition, infections in France have continued to rise since 2021, with 619 cases reported cumulatively in 2024.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今(2026)年1/31累計144國/地區報告17萬9千餘例確診病例,其中,至少483例死亡。 今年1月共計50國家/地區報告1,334 例新增確診病例,其中3例死亡,66%來自非洲地區,相較去年12月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,葛摩及法屬留旺島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/1/5-2/15)共計20國通報1,142例確診病例,其中4例死亡,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞及迦納為高;非洲以外地區,法國、葡萄牙及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 WHO 於 2 月發布全球快速風險評估,性接觸仍是跨國擴散主因,全球傳播風險評估為中,對MSM群體(尤其未固定性伴侶族群)傳播風險為中,對一般民眾傳播風險為低。 全球目前累計報告2例Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之重組病毒株,分別為於英國報告具東南亞旅遊史,以及印度報告具阿拉伯半島國家旅遊史之病患,基因定序顯示其為相同重組病毒株。WHO表示實際病例數可能多於目前通報數,惟重組病毒株臨床症狀與一般分支相,且皆無重症,接觸者追蹤亦未發現續發病例,評估整體風險維持不變。
SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. YtJ4XzfPsm1w52s1IYEDYA.en: Globally in 2025, as of 21 December, 19 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, including 4 deaths. Most were in Saudi Arabia (17 cases), and France reported 2 travel-related imported cases. Saudi Arabia reported 7 confirmed cases between 4 June and 21 December, including 2 deaths, distributed across Riyadh province in central Saudi Arabia (3 cases), Najran province in the southwest (2) and the city of Taif in the west (2), with no epidemiological link between patients. France reported 2 confirmed cases in December, both with travel history to the Arabian Peninsula; contact tracing has been completed and no secondary infection was found. WHO said the virus continues to circulate in dromedary camels, causing occasional animal-to-human transmission. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment, and care is mainly supportive. Healthcare settings are the main risk setting for human-to-human transmission. WHO recommends that countries strengthen surveillance of acute respiratory infections, implement infection prevention and control measures, and remind high-risk groups to avoid contact with camels and their products. WHO assesses the global and regional risk as moderate.

q-MJ3R-fOOCDxmf2Mbm1Kw.en: The ECDC reported that Europe recorded 6,558 food-related outbreak events in 2024, with 62,481 cases cumulatively, 3,336 hospitalisations and 53 deaths; the overall situation was higher than in 2023. Salmonella infection accounted for the largest share of food-related outbreaks, with 1,238 outbreaks. Most notifications came from France, the Netherlands, Spain and Belgium. Of these outbreaks, 65 clusters affected more than 100 people. Norovirus caused 631 outbreaks. Investigations found that common causes were cross-contamination, inadequate processing, insufficient heating and infected food handlers. Outbreaks most often occurred in schools, kindergartens, restaurants or workplaces.

pmPhKmmuKk6Vq-hrz062kQ.en: France reported 2 new imported cases. The patients had travelled together to the Arabian Peninsula; they were diagnosed after developing suspicious symptoms and are now hospitalised in stable condition. Authorities have activated prevention and control measures, and members of the tour group are under health monitoring. No secondary cases have been found so far. France had previously reported only 2 imported cases, in 2013. Globally, more than 2,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which Saudi Arabia accounts for 84%. The main animal host is the dromedary camel, and cases are mostly associated with contact with camels. There have also been cases in which healthcare workers were infected after contact with patients.

The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. ALaYwArQpeV1ZduMXTiWEA.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (5–11 October), 2,257 new cases were reported. Jiangmen City had the most, with 1,255 new cases, followed by Guangzhou (201) and Foshan (196). No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen City continues to implement Level III public health emergency response measures; its outbreak shows a fluctuating downward trend but remains at a relatively high level. Because Guangdong remains in the active season for disease-carrying mosquitoes and holiday travel continues, the risk of transmission persists. Europe: As of 8 October this year, two countries had reported cases. France recorded 63 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total to 700, and Italy has 353 cumulative locally acquired cases.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

The patient had travelled to North Africa, and the source of infection is under investigation. France has reported 26 cases cumulatively since 1970, of which 23 were imported. The previous case was an imported fatal case in 2023.

qJgL9TLtcc22cO1d5EAwng.zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情明顯上升,近1週(9/14-20)新增逾2千例病例,超過9成病例分布於江門市,無報告重症及死亡病例,該省近1週病例數較前2週(8/31-9/13)178例及201例顯著增加,江門市於9/20宣布啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,加強疫情防控。香港於9/21新增1例移入病例,於9月中旬曾到訪廣東省佛山市,香港今年累計報告22例病例,全屬移入病例,較往年每年1-11例移入病例為多。 法國疫情更新,今年累計484例本土病例,較前一週(382例)上升,病例除了分布於往年發生地區,今年首次於勃艮第-法蘭琪-康堤、中央-羅亞爾河谷、大東部、新亞奎丹大區亦發生病例。
qJgL9TLtcc22cO1d5EAwng.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen a marked recent rise: more than 2,000 new cases were reported in the past week (14–20 September), over 90% of them in Jiangmen City, and no severe or fatal cases were reported. The province's weekly case count increased significantly compared with 178 and 201 cases in the two preceding weeks (31 August–13 September). On 20 September, Jiangmen City announced activation of a Level III emergency response for public health emergencies to strengthen outbreak prevention and control. Hong Kong reported one new imported case on 21 September; the patient had visited Foshan City, Guangdong, in mid-September. Hong Kong has reported 22 cases this year, all imported, more than the 1–11 imported cases reported annually in previous years. France's outbreak update: 484 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively this year, up from 382 the previous week. In addition to areas with cases in previous years, cases have appeared for the first time this year in the Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Centre-Val de Loire, Grand Est and Nouvelle-Aquitaine regions.

_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.zh: 義大利疫情更新,今年迄今累計582例病例及39例死亡(CFR:15%),其中有260例病例發生侵犯神經系統症狀,病例主要分布於拉吉歐及坎帕亞大區。歐洲今年截至9/3,包括義大利、希臘、塞爾維亞、法國、羅馬亞、匈牙利、西班牙、阿爾巴亞及保加利亞等國均有報告本土病例。
_tRvaos7CEzruzX-wOC23g.en: Italy's outbreak update: so far this year, 582 cases and 39 deaths have been reported (CFR: 15%), of which 260 cases had neuroinvasive symptoms; cases are mainly in the Lazio and Campania regions. As of 3 September this year, locally acquired cases have been reported in Europe in several countries, including Italy, Greece, Serbia, France, Romania, Hungary, Spain, Albania and Bulgaria.

6G9eUu9ssXglNnsiI-XBJw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/31-9/6)新增178例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市85例最多,其次為廣州市40例,病例數呈下降趨勢,由於移入風險持續、部分地區病媒蚊活躍及氣候等因素,當地仍持續進行病媒蚊防治等工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增74例本土病例,今年累計301例本土病例,義大利今年累計107例本土病例。
6G9eUu9ssXglNnsiI-XBJw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (31 August–6 September), 178 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 85 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 40. Case numbers show a downward trend; because the risk of importation continues, vector mosquitoes remain active in some areas, and climatic factors, vector control work continues locally. Europe outbreak update: France reported 74 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total this year to 301 locally acquired cases. Italy has cumulatively reported 107 locally acquired cases this year.

UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共3國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告16起H5N1疫情,西班牙10起、保加利亞/挪威各3起。 共2國於2025/8/25-2025/8/29期間報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情,挪威/法國各1起。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,078起疫情,近期主要集中於加利福亞州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第34週計431個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中1州(奧勒岡州)共2個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例)、H9N2流感18例(迄今累計146例)、H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:累計57國家/地區通報2,204起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported 16 H5N1 outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, including Spain (10), and Bulgaria and Norway (3 each). Two countries reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, Norway and France (1 each). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 34, 431 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in one state (Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,204 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

QunLQo5aYaYos3HjUM__RA.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,自7/8報告首例移入病例以來,累計近1萬例病例,近1週(8/17-23)新增336例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市206例最多,其次為廣州市62例,相較於前1週(8/10-16)新增830例,病例數持續呈現下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 歐洲疫情更新,法國近1週新增45例本土病例,今年累計156例本土病例;義大利近1週新增22例本土病例,今年累計29例本土病例。
QunLQo5aYaYos3HjUM__RA.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease. Since the first imported case was reported on 8 July, nearly 10,000 cases have been cumulatively reported. In the past week (17–23 August), 336 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 206 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 62. Compared with 830 new cases in the previous week (10–16 August), case numbers continue to show a downward trend, and authorities continue outbreak prevention and control. Europe outbreak update: France reported 45 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 156 cumulative locally acquired cases this year; Italy reported 22 new locally acquired cases in the past week and has 29 cumulative locally acquired cases this year.

Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.

PniwH66yOcV9tQW5i7kSXA.zh: 中國廣東省屈公病疫情持續,今年迄今累計逾9,000例病例,近1週(8/10-16)新增830例病例,以佛山市644例最多,其次為廣州市85例,無報告重症及死亡病例,相較於前1週(8/3-9)新增1,387例病例,近期病例數呈下降趨勢。 法國疫情更新,今年截至8/12累計115例本土病例,顯示病毒於該國本土傳播風險高。
PniwH66yOcV9tQW5i7kSXA.en: Guangdong Province, China, continues its chikungunya outbreak, with more than 9,000 cases cumulatively this year. In the past week (10–16 August), 830 new cases were reported, of which 644 were in Foshan City and 85 in Guangzhou City. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Compared with the previous week (3–9 August), when 1,387 new cases were reported, case numbers show a downward trend. France's outbreak update: as of 12 August this year, 115 locally acquired cases have been reported, indicating a high risk of local transmission in the country.

XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.zh: 義大利疫情上升,今年迄今累計173例病例及11例死亡,其中72例病例出現神經症狀。歐洲今年截至8/6,包括保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、匈牙利、羅馬亞等6國均曾報告確診病例。
XBL1dWasxi2jFfcGVxhI7Q.en: Italy's outbreak is rising: so far this year, 173 cases and 11 deaths have been cumulatively reported, of which 72 cases had neurological symptoms. As of 6 August this year, six European countries, including Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy, Hungary and Romania, had reported confirmed cases.

5lbhT3VnidlBJ6It_s3HTQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,今年截至7/30,歐洲之保加利亞、法國、希臘、義大利、羅馬亞等5國均曾報告確診病例,其中以義大利中部拉蒂納省43例為多,希臘亦報告17例本土病例。
5lbhT3VnidlBJ6It_s3HTQ.en: Europe outbreak update: as of 30 July this year, Bulgaria, France, Greece, Italy and Romania had reported confirmed cases. Among them, Latina Province in central Italy reported the most, with 43 cases. Greece also reported 17 locally acquired cases.

OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/16本土病例累計30例,境外移入病例累計799例,當局表示過去疫情集中於南部地區,現已傳播至原本無疫情地區,包括東北部之大東部大區(Grand Est)以及西南部之新阿基坦大區(Nouvelle-Aquitaine),另警告本土傳播風險仍高,預期病例數持續上升。 中國廣東省佛山市自7/8報告首例境外移入後,截至7/19已累計1,199例病例,均為輕症病例,分布於佛山市順德區、南海區及禪城區。澳門7/18報告該地區今年首例,病患為61歲男性澳門居民,7/8-17前往佛山市順德區探親,17日早上出現發燒、頭痛及全身肌肉關節痛症狀,18日確診,已住院治療,同居者迄無症狀。
OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.en: France has updated its situation. As of 16 July this year, 30 locally acquired cases and 799 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities said past outbreaks were concentrated in the south but have now spread to areas that previously had no cases, including the Grand Est region in the northeast and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in the southwest. They warn that the risk of local transmission remains high and that case numbers are expected to keep rising. In Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China, 1,199 cumulative cases had been reported as of 19 July since the first imported case was reported on 8 July. All were mild and distributed across Shunde, Nanhai and Chancheng districts. Macao reported its first case of the year on 18 July: a 61-year-old male resident who visited relatives in Shunde District, Foshan, from 8 to 17 July. He developed fever, headache and generalized muscle and joint pain on the morning of 17 July, was diagnosed on 18 July, and has been hospitalized. His household contacts have shown no symptoms so far.

9UuHBFxLkLUAsUiX_xzhhQ.zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/1本土病例累計14例,大東部大區亦出現本土病例,顯示該疾病已傳播至原本無疫情地區,本土傳播風險增加。當局提醒落實報告病例、防止蚊蟲叮咬措施及控制幼蟲滋生之重要性。
9UuHBFxLkLUAsUiX_xzhhQ.en: France has updated its situation. As of 1 July this year, 14 locally acquired cases have been reported cumulatively. Locally acquired cases have also appeared in the Grand Est region, indicating the disease has spread to areas that previously had none, and the risk of local transmission has increased. Authorities remind people of the importance of reporting cases, preventing mosquito bites and controlling larval breeding.

zZrz4yjmnM2OCQ-vnLuI0w.zh: 法國北部聖康坦市(Saint-Quentin)於6/28報告28例病例,病患多為兒童,其中1例兒童死亡,10例確診為尿毒溶血症候群(HUS),部分個案仍住院中;當局調查疑感染源為當地肉品店之受汙染肉類,推測為能產生志賀毒素之高毒性菌株,該店家已停業。
zZrz4yjmnM2OCQ-vnLuI0w.en: Saint-Quentin in northern France reported 28 cases on 28 June, mostly children. One child died, and 10 cases were diagnosed with haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS), some of whom remain hospitalized. Authorities suspect the source was contaminated meat from a local butcher shop, and the strain is presumed to be a highly virulent one capable of producing Shiga toxin. The shop has closed.

t4_1vYwY_H8ThaOl54T6wQ.zh: 法國東南部普羅旺斯大區於6/11報告今年首例本土病例,個案近期無國外旅遊史,當局立即採取防治措施,降低疾病傳播風險;該國今年迄今累計報告逾900例境外移入病例。
t4_1vYwY_H8ThaOl54T6wQ.en: In the southeast of France, the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region reported this year's first locally acquired case on 11 June. The patient had no recent overseas travel history. Authorities immediately implemented control measures to reduce the risk of transmission. France has reported more than 900 cumulative imported cases so far this year.

AR5On3__qc_WYl8Rg16D2w.zh: 法國疫情更新,於5/1-20報告225例病例,約為去年全年病例數的10倍,今年迄今累計報告950餘例病例,明顯高於前2年病例數,病例主要來自法屬留旺島。因主要病媒蚊於該國之活躍期為5-11月,預期疫情將持續上升。
AR5On3__qc_WYl8Rg16D2w.en: France update: 225 cases were reported between 1 and 20 May, about 10 times the total for all of last year. So far this year, more than 950 cases have been reported cumulatively, significantly higher than in the previous two years. The cases mainly come from Réunion. Because the main vector mosquitoes are active in France from May to November, cases are expected to keep rising.

1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年4/20累計132國/地區報告13萬8,085例確診病例,其中至少317例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第16週累計68國/地區報告1萬7,373例確診病例,其中非洲區1萬4,564例、美洲區1,500例、西太平洋區344例、歐洲區913例、東南亞區26例及東地中海區26例。  其他更新:   WHO公布3/28-4/20期間共4國(英國、法國、瑞士、泰國)新增4例Ib型病例,中國新增2例Ia型病例,多數具中非地區旅遊史。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。 另針對各分支風險評估如下:  Ia分支:於DRC傳播風險為中; Ib分支:於DRC及鄰近區域傳播風險為高; II分支:於奈及利亞及中、西非區域傳播風險為中; IIb分支 : 國際傳播風險為中。
bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.en: Monthly update: as of 20 April this year, 132 countries and regions have reported 138,085 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 317 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 16 this year, 68 countries and regions have reported 17,373 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 14,564 in the African Region, 1,500 in the Region of the Americas, 344 in the Western Pacific Region, 913 in the European Region, 26 in the South-East Asia Region and 26 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: WHO reported that between 28 March and 20 April, 4 countries (the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and Thailand) reported 4 new clade Ib cases, and China reported 2 new clade Ia cases; most had travel history to Central Africa. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccine and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessment by clade: clade Ia, transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib, transmission risk in the DRC and neighboring areas is high; clade II, transmission risk in Nigeria and across Central and West Africa is moderate; clade IIb, international transmission risk is moderate.

aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.

GB3_R6yAeiFVM49eMYB1xw.zh: 法國疫情上升,今年1月病例數驟增,報告90例病例及13例死亡,其中以B血清群45%為多,其次為W血清群(30%)及Y血清群(25%)。其資料顯示腦膜炎與流感流行存在時間關聯性,感染流感增加疾病風險,呼籲民眾儘速接種腦膜炎雙球菌疫苗。
GB3_R6yAeiFVM49eMYB1xw.en: France has seen rising disease. Case numbers surged in January this year, with 90 cases and 13 deaths reported. Serogroup B accounted for the most cases at 45%, followed by serogroup W (30%) and serogroup Y (25%). Its data show a temporal link between meningitis and influenza epidemics, and influenza infection increases the risk of disease. The public is urged to get meningococcal vaccination as soon as possible.

PMC5VWxGZvfIyWmxSaxp_A.zh: 香港2/11報告1起醫院內相關疫情,累計3例病例、其中1例死亡,均為同一棟大樓之專科醫師,3例病患分別於2/4、6、10出現發燒、腹痛及腹瀉症狀。案1沒有慢性疾病,於2/6住院,7日死亡,另2例病患症狀輕微,其中1例已出院。採驗結果僅有1人呈陽性,餘為陰性(含死者),目前仍在調查感染源。香港以往每年報告約0-6例病例。 法國爆發一起與起司相關疫情,截至1/28累計報告11例病例,其中9例成人確診溶血性尿毒症候群(HUS),此產品於2024/11/12-2025/1/24期間銷售,當局已召回產品。
PMC5VWxGZvfIyWmxSaxp_A.en: On 11 February Hong Kong reported one hospital-related outbreak with 3 cumulative cases, of which 1 died. All were specialist doctors in the same building. The three patients developed fever, abdominal pain and diarrhoea on 4, 6 and 10 February respectively. Case 1 had no chronic illness, was hospitalized on 6 February and died on 7 February. The other two cases had mild symptoms, and one has been discharged. Only one person tested positive; the others, including the deceased, were negative. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported about 0–6 cases a year in the past. France reported an outbreak linked to cheese: as of 28 January, 11 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 adults with confirmed haemolytic uraemic syndrome (HUS). The product was sold between 12 November 2024 and 24 January 2025, and authorities have recalled it.

JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.zh: 歐洲報告自今年1月截至2/6,檢測出有相同基因關聯的菌株(Shigella sonnei ST152)聚集,顯示有相同的感染來源,分別為英國報告20例、奧地利/法國均為7例、荷蘭1例,其中27例有國際旅遊史,主要於亞洲國家旅行。病患介於15-70歲,多數為女性。發病期間為1/8-17,感染源仍不明,ECDC評估可能有國際間旅行傳播的可能性。
JnaKcCoFR_36KooLFEVHOw.en: From January to 6 February, Europe detected a cluster of strains with the same genetic link (Shigella sonnei ST152), indicating a common source of infection: the UK reported 20 cases, Austria and France 7 each, and the Netherlands 1. Among them, 27 cases had an international travel history, mainly to Asian countries. Patients were aged 15–70, and most were women. Illness onset was between 8 and 17 January. The source of infection remains unknown, and the ECDC assesses that transmission linked to international travel is possible.

xn0K8uHvPqyWxWOELldfVA.zh: 法國於1/6報告該國首例Ib型病例,為女性個案,感染發生在該國西部布列塔地區,感染者沒有中非等流行區旅遊史,惟曾與兩名從中非返國者有過接觸,當局刻正調查感染源,並釐清有風險之接觸者。
xn0K8uHvPqyWxWOELldfVA.en: On 6 January, France reported its first clade Ib case, a female patient. The infection occurred in Brittany in western France. The patient had no history of travel to endemic areas such as Central Africa, but had been in contact with two people who had returned from Central Africa. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and identifying contacts at risk.

5xXC_LvGhZO1As-OHS1e8g.zh: 法國近2年疫情回升,於今年3月達高峰後趨緩;今年9月單月檢出171例(陽性率8%),已趨近新冠疫情前同期水準,另今年截至9月累計報告10例死亡,其中5例為1歲以下兒童,多屬先天性感染。
5xXC_LvGhZO1As-OHS1e8g.en: Parvovirus B19 infections in France have risen over the past two years, peaking in March this year and then easing. In September alone, 171 cases were detected (positivity 8%), approaching the level of the same period before the COVID-19 pandemic. As of September this year, 10 deaths have been cumulatively reported, 5 of them in children under 1 year old, mostly due to congenital infection.

uI8I_Ote1J5BYM7XuYHXqA.zh: 義大利今年迄今累計報告194例本土病例,456例境外移入病例,無死亡病例,去年全年報告82例病例。 法國今年迄今累計報告80例本土病例,已高於2022年疫情較嚴峻的65例病例。 西班牙今年迄今累計報告8例本土病例,已高於往年病例數較高年份2018及2022年之6例病例。
uI8I_Ote1J5BYM7XuYHXqA.en:
Italy has cumulatively reported 194 locally acquired cases this year, 456 imported cases and no deaths; last year the country reported 82 cases in total.

France has cumulatively reported 80 locally acquired cases this year, already higher than the 65 cases in 2022, a more severe year.

Spain has cumulatively reported 8 locally acquired cases this year, already exceeding the 6 cases recorded in 2018 and 2022, both years with higher case numbers.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.
